newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy mkt managers must be open to foreigners -BOI.
newsitem.headline: Italy mkt managers must be open to foreigners -BOI.

text.p: Firms managing Italian markets must be open to participation by foreign intermediaries once they have been transformed from state companies into private ones, a top Bank of Italy official said on Thursday.

Tommaso Padoa Schioppa, vice director general at the Bank of Italy, said in a speech to foreign bankers: "The widespread presence of foreign operators in the main sectors of the Italian market convince us it is right to encourage them to participate in companies which will manage markets in the future."

By investing in Italian markets, intermediaries present in Italy would be able to benefit from important advantages particularly in information, deriving from the close links between companies and other Italian intermediaries.
The Italian stock market is due to be privatised in the first half this year, with companies managing the market to be private firms. (( --Milan bureau +392 66129507 ))
